name: Thunderbird
description: Shares Firefox MAR with its own pinned certs.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Thunderbird's comm-central source delegates application updates to Mozilla's shared update service; this review does not substantiate Thunderbird-specific MAR certificate pinning or an independent MAR verification configuration.
limitations: Newly retrieved official Thunderbird mirror default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; the cryptographic updater implementation is inherited from Gecko and Thunderbird-specific release build inputs were not present in comm-central.
The Firefox MAR implementation cannot be transferred to Thunderbird as evidence of its own pinned certificate set.
